#### `stc.relics.docker.crowdsec.dataDir`

Base directory for CrowdSec data and config volumes.

- **Type:** string
- **Déclarée dans:** [`relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix)

#### `stc.relics.docker.crowdsec.enable`

Whether to enable CrowdSec IDS/IPS container.

- **Type:** boolean
- **Valeur par défaut:** `false`
- **Exemple:** `true`
- **Déclarée dans:** [`relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix)

#### `stc.relics.docker.crowdsec.envFile`

Path to the environment file passed to the CrowdSec container.
Point this at whatever your secrets provider materialises
(e.g. config.sops.secrets."crowdsec/env".path).

- **Type:** null or string
- **Valeur par défaut:** `null`
- **Déclarée dans:** [`relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix)

#### `stc.relics.docker.crowdsec.image`

Docker image to use for CrowdSec. Required — STC ships no default so image
versions live with the consumer, where your own renovate scans the right
host. Set it in your host config, pinned by tag (and optionally digest):

  stc.relics.docker.crowdsec.image = "crowdsecurity/crowdsec:v1.7.8"; # renovate

- **Type:** null or string
- **Valeur par défaut:** `null`
- **Exemple:** `"crowdsecurity/crowdsec:v1.7.8"`
- **Déclarée dans:** [`relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/docker/crowdsec.nix)
